result.title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
result.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates memory-bound LLM decoding with a lightweight drafter, and parallel drafters extend this speedup by drafting a whole block in one forward pass. However, it remains unclear whether their released systems (stock) attain the full speedup that parallel drafting permits. We identify three challenges. First, with one request, each step accepts few tokens but reads every target weight. Second, with batching, per-request verification work roughly halves the speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding. Third, speculative decoding is deployment-specific, and no universal optimization fits every serving regime, drafter, target model and GPU. To address these challenges, we present SpecPilot, an autonomous agentic loop that discovers algorithms and systems optimizations for each deployment. In each round, a cost model locates the largest gaps between the current system and its ceiling. Parallel agents explore directions and integrate the successful ones. Token forcing checks every output token against stock to detect reward hacking. A structured memory carries validated mechanisms to new rounds and deployments. SpecPilot discovered a general lossless 12-bit weight format, tree verification for hybrid recurrent targets, two-level verification and three batching mechanisms. We evaluate it across four target models, three drafters, two GPU platforms and five benchmarks. Without training or quality loss, it raises the speedup over AR from stock's 4.46$\times$ to 10.87$\times$ with one request, and from 1.94$\times$ to 3.93$\times$ with batching.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SpecPilot，用自主 agent 循环为每种部署自动发现 speculative decoding 的算法与系统优化，包括 12-bit 权重格式、树验证与批处理机制，在多个模型、GPU 和基准上把相对 AR 的加速比从 4.46× 提升到 10.87×。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「草稿—验证」流程与用成本模型定位算力缺口的做法，可能可供核查如何迁移到 latent 推理轨迹的并行候选生成、验证与动态计算分配，但与视觉证据保留无直接关系。
